title: Media Inquiry: Channel 4 — “we control your water”

fields.message: A viewer sent us a screenshot of a ransom note with the City seal that says “we control your water.” Is it real? Can the hackers change what comes out of the tap? We go live at noon.

instructorNote: Watch for the PIO confirming the note or the demand (wrong), and for the approved line plus a plain statement of what is being tested.

snapshot.title: Media Inquiry: Channel 4 — Water Safety and Smell in Zone 3

fields.message: This is Greg Ransom, Channel 4 News, reporting from Zone 3. We're on the ground here and residents are without water. One neighbor says the water smells like chlorine. Another says they’ve been told to boil water but don’t know why. We’ve seen no official statement. Is the plant down? Is the water safe? We’re going live in 90 seconds.

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a high-pressure media inquiry. The PIO must not confirm or deny the water smell or boil-water claim; instead, they must activate the cyber holding statement from MDWS-PCP-2026, Section 10, and notify the Director and Water Quality Manager. The team must not draft a public advisory until facts are verified.
